mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS shows a sustained downward trend over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% year-over-year) and aggressive monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and aggressive monetary tightening
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 6.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 monthly additions signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a tightening monetary policy cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market contraction (HOUST declining for two consecutive months), consumer confidence and spending weaken, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines for two consecutive months.
